CreateTextRange.description: Creates a text body for the drawing if it does not already exist and returns its full text range.

GetApplicationId.description: Returns the application ID from the current OLE object.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiOleObject class.

GetData.description: Returns the string data from the current OLE object.

GetHyperlink.description: Returns the hyperlink from the current drawing object (shape or image).

returns.description: Returns the hyperlink object or null if no hyperlink is set.

GetInternalId.description: Returns an internal ID of the current drawing object.

GetParentLayout.description: Returns the drawing parent slide layout.

returns.description: return null if parent ins't a slide layout.

GetParentMaster.description: Returns the drawing parent slide master.

returns.description: return null if parent ins't a slide master.
return null if parent ins't a slide.

GetPlaceholder.description: Returns a placeholder from the current drawing object.

returns.description: returns null if placeholder doesn't exist.

GetPosX.description: Gets the x position of the drawing on the slide.

GetPosY.description: Gets the y position of the drawing on the slide.

GetTextRange.description: Returns an ApiTextRange covering the full text content of the shape, or null if the shape has no text body (use CreateTextRange to create one).

IsTextRange.description: Checks whether the drawing has an associated text body.

ReplacePlaceholder.description: Replaces the placeholder by a drawing on the slide.

params.description: The drawing object that will replace the placeholder.
params.name: drawing

SetApplicationId.description: Sets the application ID to the current OLE object.

params.description: The application ID associated with the current OLE object.
params.name: sAppId

SetData.description: Sets the data to the current OLE object.

SetHyperlink.description:
Sets a hyperlink to the current drawing object (shape or image).
Pass null to remove the hyperlink.

params.description: The hyperlink object to be set to the drawing, or null to remove the hyperlink.
params.name: hyperlink

returns.description: Returns true if the hyperlink was set or removed successfully.

SetPlaceholder.description: Sets the specified placeholder to the current drawing object.

returns.description: returns false if parameter isn't a placeholder.

SetPosX.description: Sets the x position of the drawing on the slide.

params.description: The distance from the left side of the slide to the left side of the drawing measured in English measure units.
params.name: posX

SetPosY.description: Sets the y position of the drawing on the slide.

params.description: The distance from the top side of the slide to the upper side of the drawing measured in English measure units.
params.name: posY

SetPosition.description: Sets the position of the drawing on the slide.

params.description: The distance from the left side of the slide to the left side of the drawing measured in English measure units.
params.name: nPosX

params.description: The distance from the top side of the slide to the upper side of the drawing measured in English measure units.
params.name: nPosY
